single_cell_aga2.description_text:
single cell aga2
Includes growth plate and perichondrial cell states from the Col1a1Aga2/+ mouse OI model, including articular, precartilage, resting, proliferative, pre-hypertrophic and hypertrophic chondrocytes, perichondrial cells, pericyte/endothelial cells and platelets.

single_cell_mouse_basic_atlas.description_text:
single cell mouse basic atlas
Includes integrated mouse skeletal cell states across osteoblasts, osteocytes, chondrocytes, stromal progenitors, marrow-associated stromal cells, vascular/perivascular cells, immune cells and muscle-associated populations.

single_cell_human_basic_atlas.description_text:
single cell human basic atlas
Includes human developmental skeletal cell states from the To et al.
Human Developmental Cell Atlas dataset, covering osteogenic, chondrogenic, articular/interzone-associated, vascular, muscle, dermal, synovial, tendon and precursor populations.
